Class ControlPanelCaptureSection

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.control.ControlPanelCaptureSection
public class ControlPanelCaptureSection extends Object
Capture and telemetry card for ControlPanel.

Extracted from ControlPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Provides high-definition raster snapshot export (PNG) and background MP4 video timelapse generation.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
